
На этой странице приведены различные списки слов Ложбана. На сегодняшний день все они на английском языке, что печально. В ближайшее время сюда будут выложены списки слов на русском языке (gismu и cmavo).

=== Списки слов на английском языке: ===

* The current authoritative lists of [http://www.lojban.org/publications/wordlists/cmavo.txt mavo], [http://www.lojban.org/publications/wordlists/gismu.txt ismu], and [http://www.lojban.org/publications/wordlists/rafsi.txt afsi].
* The same gismu list sorted into [http://www.lojban.org/publications/wordlists/gismu_english_order.txt nglish keyword order].

* The cmavo list sorted in [http://www.lojban.org/publications/wordlists/cmavo_selmaho_order.txt elma'o order].
* Four versions of the current lujvo list: [http://www.lojban.org/publications/draft-dictionary/NORALUJV.txt urrent], [http://www.lojban.org/publications/wordlists/lujvo.txt ld], [http://www.lojban.org/publications/wordlists/lujvo_old.txt lder], and [http://www.lojban.org/publications/wordlists/lujvo_ancient.txt ncient].

* The list of [[Old Pages: Untranslated Words ords, requiring translation|Untranslated Words ords, requiring translation]]
* A translation of the gismu list into [http://www.lojban.org/publications/wordlists/gismu_spanish.txt panish].

* [http://www.lojban.org/publications/wordlists/frequencies.txt requencies] of words in Lojban text.  (large file: >1 megabyte)
* A file of [http://www.lojban.org/publications/wordlists/oblique_keywords.txt eywords for oblique places] of gismu (all other than x1).

* A mapping between [http://www.lojban.org/publications/wordlists/oldlog.txt ld Loglan prims] and Lojban gismu.
* [http://www.lojban.org/publications/wordlists/roget.txt oget's Thesaurus] codes for Lojban gismu (roget).

* The [http://www.lojban.org/publications/wordlists/public_domain.txt ublic domain declaration] for these materials.

See also the [[Old Pages: Old Draft Dictionary|Old Draft Dictionary]] for additional current wordlists.
